rounds.fact: ICQ (a pun on 'I seek you') launched in 1996 and is widely credited as the first mass-market instant messaging program, complete with its now-iconic 'uh-oh' message sound.
Epicurious launched in 1995 as one of the first major recipe websites, built from the archives of Condé Nast's food magazines like Gourmet and Bon Appétit.
CitySearch was one of the first sites to organize local business listings and reviews by city, years before Yelp or Google Maps made that kind of local search completely routine.
Charles Schwab was one of the first traditional brokerages to fully embrace online trading, helping legitimize the idea for investors who didn't trust newer online-only upstarts.
Opera was one of the first browsers to introduce tabbed browsing and built-in mouse gestures, features that later became standard across every major browser.
